vision.name: Android 18
vision.text:
(If this card would leave play and your MP is Krillin, you may shuffle it into your Life Deck instead. If your MP is Krillin or Android 17, you may use this Power regardless of your MP's power stage.)
[Defense] POWER: Stops an attack.
You may choose a card in your discard pile and Rejuvenate it. If you do, shuffle this card into your Life Deck after use.
